profile.headline: Software Developer at CipherHealth
profile.summary:
Pablo Díaz is a software developer based on NYC specializing in .Net architecture, design and coding. He has been working in IT around 10+ years and has worked primarily in the financial sector.

Pablo obtained his bachelor degree in computer science back in 2004, mention of
honor Magna Cum Laude. Since then he’ve been involved in a variety of software
development projects, ranging from backend services to user experience design.
Currently, He's orienting his career around UI design and coding, but also thinks
his understanding of both server and client side technologies is an invaluable
asset at the moment of making architectural decisions.

Over the course of his career he have had the opportunity to lead a team of
developers, and in other occasions follow the lead of the current manager. Most
of the projects he and his team worked in were successfully released and actively being used
by their users. The greatest satisfaction he gets from his profession is to hear from
his users how cool and simple the new interface is, or how with couple of clicks
they can complete that task which otherwise would have taken them half a day of
manual processes.

Pablo always keeps himself updated on the latest technologies, read about every new
popular framework and focus on mastering those he considers will have a higher
impact on the future.

projects.title: Referential Data Store - RDS (Bank of Montreal)
projects.description:
The global security master consolidates securities information from various systems, both external and internal. The UI allows the user to enter new securities, as well as editing existing securities and referential information. The application also has an API to allow other internal applications to obtain
securities data.

Role & Responsibilities:
• Lead Web Developer
• Create a template generation tool for generation of standard views and controllers (UI). This template generation tool will allow for UI creation automation in similar future projects.

Technologies: Visual Studio 2013, Photoshop, Illustrator, .NET 4.5, C#, ASP.NET MVC 5, HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, JQuery, AngularJS, Twitter Bootstrap, jqWidgets, LESS, Autofac.

projects.title: Employee Portal (First New York)
projects.description:
The employee portal is a full feature Intranet used to post internal news and events about the company to the employees. The Intranet allows employees to share files and access reports catalogs. Employees can also search any digital term inside of the company or find people of interests inside the directory.

Role & Responsibilities:
• Designed initial site template using Photoshop and Illustrator
• Converted the graphic design to HTML, CSS and Javascript output
• Development of web controls and pages required on the Intranet

Technologies: Visual Studio 2010, Photoshop, Illustrator, .NET 4.0, C#, ASP.NET Web Forms, HTML, CSS, Javascript, JQuery, Enterprise Library, SQL Server.
